concerns.text: The plan relies on 'regex-based tagging' to extract mindfulness components and delivery formats. This is a high-risk approach to construct validity; keyword matching cannot reliably distinguish between the presence of a component, its absence, or its mention in a non-primary role within trial descriptions.

FR-008 specifies 'splitting control groups proportionally' for multi-arm studies. This is methodologically ambiguous. If a study has one treatment and multiple controls, creating multiple effect sizes from the same treatment group can lead to double-counting and artificial inflation of the sample size in the meta-analysis.
